dow_theory_tenets.name: The Market Discounts Everything
dow_theory_tenets.description: All known and unknowable information is already reflected in market prices. Prices represent the collective knowledge of all participants.

dow_theory_tenets.name: The Market Has Three Trends
dow_theory_tenets.description: Primary trend lasts 1+ years, secondary trend lasts 3 weeks to 3 months as a correction, minor trend lasts less than 3 weeks as short-term fluctuations.

dow_theory_tenets.name: Primary Trends Have Three Phases
dow_theory_tenets.description: Bull market: accumulation, public participation, excess/distribution. Bear market: distribution, public participation, panic/despair.

dow_theory_tenets.name: Indices Must Confirm Each Other
dow_theory_tenets.description: No important bull or bear signal can occur unless both the Dow Jones Industrial and Transportation averages confirm the signal.

dow_theory_tenets.name: Volume Must Confirm the Trend
dow_theory_tenets.description: Volume should expand in the direction of the primary trend and contract on counter-trend moves. Rising prices with rising volume confirms uptrend.

dow_theory_tenets.name: A Trend Is Assumed to Continue Until It Gives Definite Reversal Signals
dow_theory_tenets.description: An established trend is presumed to continue until clear evidence of a reversal appears. Doubt should be resolved in favor of the existing trend.

primary.description: The main market direction, also called the tide. Most important for investors.

secondary.description: Counter-move against the primary trend, also called the wave. Typically retraces 33% to 66% of the prior primary move.

minor.description: Short-term fluctuations within the secondary trend, also called ripples. Less significant for trend analysis.

uptrend_definition.description: Each successive peak is higher than the prior peak and each successive trough is higher than the prior trough.
uptrend_definition.confirmation_rule: Uptrend intact as long as each HL holds above the prior HL

downtrend_definition.description: Each successive peak is lower than the prior peak and each successive trough is lower than the prior trough.
downtrend_definition.confirmation_rule: Downtrend intact as long as each LH is below the prior LH

sideways_definition.description: Price oscillates between relatively equal highs and lows with no clear directional bias.

trend_continuation_signals.signal: Pullback to prior resistance turned support
trend_continuation_signals.description: Price breaks above resistance, pulls back to test the level, holds, and resumes upward
Each correction in an uptrend terminates at a higher price than the previous correction low
Volume increases on the trending legs and decreases on pullbacks
Brief consolidation on declining volume followed by breakout with volume expansion
Price consistently finds support at a key moving average (e.g., 20 EMA in strong trends)

trend_reversal_signals.signal: Break of Higher Low (HL) in uptrend
trend_reversal_signals.description: Price closes below the most recent HL, suggesting the uptrend structure has been violated
Price rallies but fails to exceed the prior peak, forming a lower high
First structural break against the prevailing trend direction after a run of trend-aligned breaks
Price breaks through a significant swing high/low in the opposite direction of the trend
Extremely high volume accompanied by a reversal candlestick pattern at a key level
Price makes new highs/lows but momentum indicator fails to confirm, indicating weakening trend

uptrend_healthy.interpretation: Demand exceeds supply on rallies; sellers are not aggressive on pullbacks

uptrend_weakening.interpretation: Demand is fading; supply is increasing; trend likely to reverse

downtrend_healthy.interpretation: Supply exceeds demand on declines; buyers are not aggressive on rallies

downtrend_weakening.interpretation: Selling pressure is fading; potential accumulation underway

climax_volume.description: Extremely high volume at the end of a trend move indicating exhaustion
climax_volume.bullish_climax: selling climax at the bottom — potential trend reversal up
climax_volume.bearish_climax: buying climax at the top — potential trend reversal down

agent_rules.condition: price forms HH and HL sequence on chosen timeframe
agent_rules.action: classify trend as UPTREND; bias long setups only

agent_rules.condition: price forms LH and LL sequence on chosen timeframe
agent_rules.action: classify trend as DOWNTREND; bias short setups only

agent_rules.condition: price breaks below most recent HL in an uptrend
agent_rules.action: flag potential trend reversal; reduce long bias; wait for confirmation

agent_rules.condition: volume expands on impulse and contracts on correction
agent_rules.action: confirm trend health; continue trend-following bias

agent_rules.condition: volume expands against trend direction on corrective leg
agent_rules.action: flag trend weakness; tighten stops; avoid new entries in trend direction

agent_rules.condition: secondary indices fail to confirm primary index new high/low
agent_rules.action: note non-confirmation per Dow Theory; treat signal as suspect until confirmation

agent_rules.condition: trend classification unclear — overlapping highs and lows
agent_rules.action: classify as SIDEWAYS; apply range-trading rules; avoid trend-following entries
